आणि॑ इस्, m. (cf. अणि) the pin of the axle of a cart, RV. i, 35, 6; 63, 3 [‘battle’, Naigh. ii, 17], and v, 43, 8
the part of the leg just above the knee, Suśr.
आणि॑ इस्, m. f. a linchpin, L.
the corner of a house, L.
a boundary, L.
अणीचि m. or f. bamboo, cane, L.
a carter, L.
अणीचिन् m. N. of a man (having the patr. Mauna), ŚāṅkhBr.
अणी-माण्डव्य m. N. of a Brāhman ascetic (said to have been impaled on an अणि or point of a stake), MBh.
अणिम॑न् m. (fr. अणु, q.v.), minuteness, fineness, thinness, ŚBr. &c.
meagreness
atomic nature, the superhuman power of becoming as small as an atom
अ॑णिमन् n. the smallest particle, ŚBr.
अणिम-त॑स् ind. from the thin side, MaitrS.
अणिष्ठ mfn. (fr. अणु, q.v.), most minute.
अ॑णीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (fr. अणु, q.v.), or अणीयस्क॑ [AV.], mfn. more minute than usual.
